findings.fix: Check which units are complete sentences and which fragments need connection.
findings.keep_when: Keep dialogue, slogans, instructions and deliberate emphasis.

findings.sentence: We have introduced new “science of reading” training (which emphasizes phonics, a positive step), but without a dedicated expert to guide implementation, it hasn’t yielded big gains yet.
findings.suggestion: stress
findings.why: A familiar general word may hide the action or property intended.
findings.fix: Use the precise term or an ordinary verb if it preserves meaning.
findings.keep_when: Keep technical terms such as robust statistics, quoted language and the author’s intentional voice.

Three sentence lengths within ±3 words are a reading prompt; headings and lists are excluded.
A digit-bearing token is a checkable-detail prompt, not verification of a claim.
Name actual evidence; this check cannot verify sources.
Retain contrasts that clarify a distinction.
